senses.gloss: सु-गन्ध- + आदित्य सु-गन्ध- + आदित्य, m. a proper name, Rājat. 5, 268.

सु- + गन्ध सु- + गन्ध,
 I. adj. sweet-smelling.
 II. m. 1. fragrance. 2. sulphur.
 III. f. धा, 1. the name of several plants. 2. a proper name.
 IV. n. the name of several plants.
सु- + गन्धिन् सु- + गन्धिन्, adj. smelling agreeably, Arj. 4, 51.
सु- + गम् सु- + गम् m. a Buddha.
सु- + गम सु- + गम, adj. 1. accessible. 2. easy, MBh. 13, 7535. 3. plain, intelligible.
सु- + गुणिन् सु- + गुणिन्, adj. virtuous, Bhartṛ. 2, 54.
सु-गुप्त सु-गुप्त, adj. well concealed, Lass. 15, 3. ˚तम्, adv. privily, Pañc. 231, 17.
सु- + गुप्ति सु- + गुप्ति, f. secrecy, Hit. iv. d. 51 (closeness).
सु-गृह सु-गृह, adj., f. ही, having a beautiful abode, Pañc. i. d. 435.

सु- + ग्रीव सु- + ग्रीव,
 I. adj. handsome-necked.
 II. m. [] 1. a goose. 2. a hero. 3. a sort of weapon. 4. one of Kṛṣṇa's horses. 5. a proper name. 6. Indra. 7. Śiva. 8. a serpent of the lower regions. 9. the name of a mountain.

सुग सु-ग,
 I. adj.
 1. Going well.
 2. Graceful.
 3. Well rid of.
 4. Plain, intelligible.
 5. Easy of access, Pañc. ii. d. 151.
 II. n. Fæces, ordure.
सुगोपा सु-गोपा (गोपा, ved. = गोप), adj. Having a good protector, Chr. 292, 1 = Rigv. i. 86, 1.
सुग्म्य सुग्म्य, i. e. सु-गम् + अ + य, adj. Yielding happiness, Chr. 288, 13 = Rigv. i. 48, 13.
